properties.evidence: Not a veto — a raised threshold, and BLOCKS is the closest true relation the vocabulary offers. Before 2026-08-24 `max_flow_min_cut` was linked and callable, so this idea was 'use a function we already have'. This capability absorbed only what reflow2 calls and left `maxflow.rs` (248 lines) upstream, so acting on the idea now means retrieving a file from tag v0.12.0 first. The same holds for `dec:idea-other-centralities`, `dec:idea-missing-edge-prediction` and `dec:idea-relevance-ranking`; this edge is drawn on the sharpest instance rather than four times over, because relatedness is not similarity.
